verdict.rationale: This is a fair question for an IP office, which could publish agent-appointment and authorization rules, so the axis applies. The only related item is a 'Find a licensed patent agent' directory link (cipo-docs-18). That is an adjacent feature: it does not publish what an agent may or may not do, any authorization or appointment forms, role definitions, or which signatures must stay personal to the applicant.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
